newsitem.title: USA: Methode buys intellectual property firm.
newsitem.headline: Methode buys intellectual property firm.

text.p: Methode Electronics Inc said Tuesday it acquired 75 percent of the common stock of privately held Sentorque Inc, which owns a portfolio of intellectual property covering advances in circulary magnetized non-contact torque sensors.
There are several large manufacturers licensed to produce products under license agreements, and the company anticipates this number will grow substantially.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
"The inventions utilize the magnetoelastic properties of metals for inexpensive non-contact measurement of torsional stress on a shaft," said Methode chairman William McGinley.
"The low price of the sensor is expected to open broad new markets including automotive electric steering, power transmission, industrial machinery and consumer goods," McGinley said.
